West Palm Beach.hecho: In West Palm Beach, fences and fence pool barriers on residential properties require a permit regardless of cost, and pools require their own separate permit.
West Palm Beach.evidencia: Fences and fence pool barriers require a permit regardless of cost in residential properties, even if other work valued at less than $7,500 might be exempt. ... pools require a separate permit that must be secured independently from other work like electrical or plumbing.

West Palm Beach.hecho: West Palm Beach says a shed requires a permit and must meet zoning setbacks and resist hurricane wind loads.
West Palm Beach.evidencia: A shed must meet zoning setbacks and must resist wind loads in a hurricane, and yes, a shed requires a permit.

West Palm Beach.hecho: West Palm Beach's exemption for minor residential work under $7,500 does not cover structural work, fences or driveways, and work done without a required permit must be removed under permit or permitted at 4 times the regular fee.
West Palm Beach.evidencia: Building permit exemptions for minor residential work valued at less than $7,500 do not include structural work, fences, or driveways ... you will be required to get a permit to remove the work, or you will have to pay a penalty fee of 4 times the regular permit fee to obtain a permit for the work.

West Palm Beach.hecho: West Palm Beach's tree alteration permit costs $25 for a single-family residence plus $5 per additional tree, and removing or relocating six or more trees requires a certified tree survey and a landscape plan.
West Palm Beach.evidencia: Tree alteration permit application fees are $25 for single family residences and $50 for multi-family residential or non-residential properties, with an additional $5 fee per tree for each tree beyond the first one ... A certified tree survey is required for the removal or relocation of six or more trees, along with a landscape plan designating trees to be preserved, relocated, and/or removed.

Boca Raton.hecho: Boca Raton's Residential Swimming Pool Safety Act form says a pool fails final inspection unless it has one of the listed safety features: a compliant barrier, an approved safety cover, exit alarms on doors and windows, self-closing and self-latching door devices, or an ASTM F2208 pool alarm.
Boca Raton.evidencia: One of several safety features must be in place upon final inspection or the pool will fail the inspection ... pool barrier ... approved safety pool cover ... Exit alarms on all doors and windows ... minimum sound pressure rating of 85 dB A at 10 feet ... Self-closing, self-latching devices ... release mechanism placed no lower than 54 inches above the floor ... swimming pool alarm ... ASTM Standard F2208

Boca Raton.hecho: Boca Raton's swimming pool package requires either a new barrier permit application or a current survey showing where the existing barrier is.
Boca Raton.evidencia: swimming pools must have a barrier and gate hardware complying with building codes, with a new barrier permit application or current survey showing existing barrier location that must be submitted.

Boca Raton.hecho: In Boca Raton, a certified Notice of Commencement is required on building permits over $5,000, and all subcontractor applications must be submitted before the permit is issued.
Boca Raton.evidencia: A certified Notice of Commencement (NOC) is required on building permits with a value greater than $5,000, and all contractors must pull permits, and all subcontractor applications are required before permit issuance.

Boca Raton.hecho: Boca Raton treats screen enclosures as accessory structures that need their own permit application and permit number.
Boca Raton.evidencia: Screen enclosures are classified as accessory structures that require separate permit applications with separate permit numbers.

Boynton Beach.hecho: Boynton Beach's local amendment to FBC Chapter 1 lists pool inspections after excavation, for underground electric and piping, and for the deck, plus final electric and final permanent barrier inspections before filling, and a final inspection when the pool is complete.
Boynton Beach.evidencia: Pool construction inspections must be conducted at various stages including after excavation, underground electric and piping inspections, deck inspection, final electric inspection prior to filling, final permanent barrier inspection prior to filling, and final inspection when the swimming pool is complete.
